notes: Two determiner counts decide the verse: the demonstrative phrase הָאִישׁ הַהוּא writes two articles against the single *this*, which the pronoun licenses (rule 41's limit); and כָּל בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם writes no article morpheme at all, so both of the ASV's *the*s are supplied, each going to the word it stands before (rule 29's multi-level clause).
The waw s025 takes the pair *so that* as one rendering of its own recast clause, headed on the coordinator; the competing head on *that* is named in that unit (rule 55).
אֲתוֹנוֹת → *she asses* heads on *asses*, *she* being a specifier added to a word that already names the animal (rule 31).
